items.text: The Project Agreement (once executed) and its recitals;
Addenda (in reverse chronological order, latest governing);
The Functional Program (Appendix OPR-1 to this OPR);
The RFP main document (NREOCRC-RFP-001), to the extent it contains technical requirements not otherwise addressed in this OPR;
Accepted Proposal Commitments (governing over this OPR only to the extent they exceed, and do not derogate from, OPR requirements);
The Indicative Design Package (Indicative only, illustrative of design intent, not mandatory except where an element is expressly designated Mandatory therein);
Data Room reference material (Reference/Informational only, provided for Design-Builder's own investigation and not warranted by the Owner except as expressly stated).
